Method of Attack: Encrypts files using AES encryption and renames them with a ROT-13 of the original filename plus a ransom email and victim ID extension
Scans for files to encrypt excluding whitelisted folders
Creates ransom note #_RESTORING_FILES_#.TXT in each folder with encrypted files
Displays fake application error alert to trick victim into elevating ransomware execution
Uses WMIC to launch elevated ransomware process to disable Windows recovery and delete shadow copies
Sends victim ID and encryption key to Command & Control server
Encrypts files on unmapped network shares
